subject: general
question: Who among the following was named as Vice-President of Asian Development Bank in July 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashok Lavasa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ashok Lavasa** has been named **Vice-President for Private Sector Operations and Public-Private Partnerships **at the **Asian Development Bank (ADB)**.
 
• He took the place of Diwakar Gupta, whose term ended on August 31, 2020.
 
• He is a former Haryana cadre Indian Administrative Service officer who was one of India's two Election Commissioners.
 
• He has also held the positions of India's Finance Secretary, Environment, Forests and Climate Change Secretary, and Civil Aviation Secretary.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **The Asian Development Bank (ADB)** is a regional development bank headquartered in the Ortigas Center in Mandaluyong, Metro Manila, **Philippines**. It was founded on December 19, **1966**.
 
• In addition, the corporation operates 31 field offices in Asia to support social and economic development.
 
• Non-regional developed countries and members of the United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific (UNESCAP, formerly the Economic Commission for Asia and the Far East or ECAFE) are allowed to join the bank.
 
• ADB presently has 68 members, up from 31 when it was founded. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Deepak Parekh** is the Chairman of Housing Development Finance Corporation, India's largest housing finance corporation.
 
• **Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw** is the former chairman of the Indian Institute of Management, Bangalore, and the executive chairperson and founder of Biocon Limited and Biocon Biologics Limited, a biotechnology firm situated in Bangalore, India.
 
• **Adi Burjorji Godrej **is an Indian businessman and industrialist who is the patriarch of the Godrej family and the chairman of the Godrej Group.
